title: Solar-driven active and reusable immobilized fluorine-doped ZrO2−x thin film photocatalyst for dye-contaminated water
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21805-21816
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01876A, Paper

An immobilized fluorine-doped ZrO2−x thin film photocatalyst was synthesized on glass substrates using the pulsed spray pyrolysis (PSP) technique for the first time and its solar-driven photocatalytic mechanism.
